paper_title: Prospects of nuclear-coupled-dark-matter detection via correlation spectroscopy of I$_2^+$ and Ca$^+$
notes: Projection (proposed experiment) for scalar ULDM coupling to gluons d_g via I2+/Ca+ correlation spectroscopy. Text states projected reach dg >~ 1e-5 * (m_phi/1e-18 eV) over mass range ~1e-21 to 1e-14 eV; data points computed from this linear scaling. Paper also projects axion decay constant fa (Fig 3b) which maps to AxionMass; d_g gluon coupling is here mapped to ScalarBaryon per enum note, but could alternatively be ScalarNucleon (nucleon-mass coupling) — hence reduced confidence.
